Fact: Car 5 moved under braking into Turn 5.
Infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
Reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 5 moved under braking when approaching Turn 5 and impacted Car 43 in a way that Car 43 had to leave the track. The Stewards acknowledge that a black/white flag is the baseline penalty for such infringement. For the sake of clarity, after having investigated this incident, the Stewards decide to issue a Warning (which is the equivalent to a black/white flag).
